Collection of your Personal Information Unless provided specifically to make a reservation, we do not collect personally identifiable information from our users without consent. We may gather personal or non-personal information in the future with clear and apparent consent. Information about your computer hardware and software may be automatically collected by Cut & Taste. This information can include: your IP address, browser type, domain names, access times and referring website addresses. This information is used for the operation of the service, to maintain the quality of the services and to provide general statistics regarding use of the Cut & Taste website. Personal information includes any information that you voluntarily submit to us via email or through our website and that identifies you personally, including contact information, such as your name, e-mail address, company name, address, phone number, and other information about yourself. Personal Information can also include information about you that is available on the internet, such as from Facebook, LinkedIn, Twitter and Google, or publicly available information that we acquire from service providers. Cut & Taste_accessibility.full_text_sample: Accessibility Statement — Cut and Taste Please ensure Javascript is enabled for purposes of website accessibility About Clients Venues Gallery The Team Contact (702) 270-0299 Back About Client Feedback Blog (702) 270-0299 About About Client Feedback Blog Clients Venues Gallery The Team Contact Accessibility Statement Our Commitment to Accessibility At Cut and Taste Las Vegas, we are committed to making our digital and physical spaces inclusive and accessible to everyone, including people with disabilities. We believe in providing an equitable experience to all guests, and we continually strive to improve the usability of our website and services. Guidelines and Conformance As part of our ongoing efforts, we are actively working toward following and conforming to the Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG) 2.2 , at the Level AA standard. These guidelines explain how to make web content more accessible to people with a wide range of disabilities. By following these guidelines, we aim to ensure our website is usable by all individuals. Contact Us & Feedback We are continually seeking to improve the accessibility of our website and services. If you experience any difficulty accessing our website, have trouble reading our menus, or require assistance with any other aspect of our services, please let us know. We are here to help! Contact us to reach our team. Queen of Hearts), we collect and manage user data according to the following Privacy Policy and Terms of Service , and by using queenofheartscatering.com (the “Website”), you agree to the terms of this Privacy Policy and the Terms of Service. Privacy Policy Data Collected We collect anonymous data from every visitor of the Website to monitor traffic and fix bugs. For example, we collect information like web requests, the data sent in response to such requests, the Internet Protocol address, the browser type, the browser language, and a timestamp for the request. On occasion, we may ask you to provide certain personal information (such as your name and email address) in order to be able to receive communications. You are able to remove your data associated with your profile. Should you choose to delete your information, please contact us and we will follow up as soon as possible. Minors and children should not use Queen of Hearts. By using the Website, you represent that you have the legal capacity to enter into a binding agreement. Use of the Data We only use your personal information to provide you the Queen of Hearts services or to communicate with you about the services or the Website. We employ industry standard techniques to protect against unauthorized access of data about you that we store, including personal information. We do not share personal information you have provided to us without your consent, unless: • doing so is appropriate to carry out your own request; • we believe it’s needed to enforce our Terms of Service, or that is legally required; • we believe it’s needed to detect, prevent or address fraud, security or technical issues; • otherwise protect our property, legal rights, or that of others.
